note: A drawing of the west side of Prairie Avenue from 20th to 18th Street, each front over its printed number. The front over 1900 (the Elbridge Keith house) is drawn with a steep mansard roof carrying dormers with round-headed windows, a bracketed cornice under it, arched windows under hoods and a high stoop. The front over 1834 (the Fernando Jones house) is drawn three storeys high under a mansard with a cluster of dormers, as it stood after its 1886 addition. A guidebook drawing, not a measured one.
what_it_supplies: the 1900 front's mansard roof, dormers, arched windows and stoop as drawn in 1893
the 1834 front's mansard top as drawn in 1893
what_it_does_not_supply: the side walls and the rear
